title: Polynomial-Time Value Threshold Test
statement: Let a polynomial-time map compute an output string from each binary input, and let an encoded maximization problem assign a rational value to each input and output string. For any rational threshold, a polynomial-time map is a value-threshold test if, on every input, it outputs the one-bit string containing true exactly when the value of the computed output is at least the threshold, and false otherwise.
